Name: Find Your Own Seeds
Author: giovannim
Description:
EDIT: The mixed seed portion is moving to it's own file here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22311/
The current mod should only remove seeds from shops! I still plan to hopefully add more mixed seeds finding methods though

Also recommending this seedmaker mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/45628237]WoosterUK[/url] from the posts! : https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22231/
This should make progression a little easier!

I made this mod because the seeds are rare / seed shortage / better mixed seeds mods all appear to be broken, and I like to play with them because otherwise I progress farming way too fast. The old mixed seeds mod had more compatibility than I know how to do with other mods, but you should be able to get just about anything from vanilla with the following exceptions:

Ancient Fruit: You can get these from monster drops or the traveling cart, so there's no need to get them from mixed seeds.
Sweet Gem Berry: Similar reason, you can get this the same as you always would from the cart
Pineapple / Taro Root: I'm letting these drops stay as part of ginger island, where you get them from means other than just buying them.
Carrot/SummerSquash/Brocolli: Again, I could add these, but you can already get them from artifact spots, which isn't in shops and need to be scavenged anyways
Flowers: There are now mixed flower seeds to use instead!

This is my first mod, so I wanted to start small, but eventually if I have time, I'd like to make it more configurable somehow and maybe add some new mechanics/concepts to expand on this gameplay style.

Compatibility-wise, I haven't tested it extensively, but it shouldn't mess with too much I think? Let me know about any problems!

Downloads.Description: Just removes vanilla seeds from shops
